visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up shot of a steaming bowl of tomato, radish, and pork rib soup in a bright, modern kitchen. A hand holding chopsticks lifts a tender piece of pork rib to show the texture. Yellow and white text overlays appear at the top and center, introducing the recipe. (2) The scene transitions to hands placing dried shiitake mushrooms into a clear glass container. Warm water is poured from a black kettle over the mushrooms. A white vacuum pump is placed on the lid and operated several times to speed up the soaking process. (3) Raw pork ribs are placed in a clear bowl of water and massaged by hand to clean them. The hands then transfer the cleaned ribs to a red Le Creuset pot. A whole white radish is shown being peeled with a metal peeler until smooth, then its ends are sliced off. (4) The radish is chopped into large chunks on a wooden board. Frozen tomatoes are placed in a bowl of water, allowing the skin to be easily peeled off by hand. The peeled tomatoes are then chopped into large pieces. (5) In the red pot, the ribs and radish chunks are combined. Sake and cold water are poured in. The soaked mushrooms and a spoonful of white rice are added. The pot is heated on a black induction stove, and a metal strainer is used to skim off white foam from the boiling broth. (6) Chopped tomatoes, white pepper, soup bags, mirin, and salt are added to the pot. The red lid is placed on top. A series of cuts show the simmering process, the removal of the soup bag, and further simmering until the radish is translucent and the ribs are soft. (7) The finished soup is ladled into a pink bowl. Fresh green cilantro is placed on top as a garnish. A woman with short dark hair and a pink apron is seen tasting the soup and eating the rib, smiling with satisfaction and nodding to the camera in a bright, indoor setting.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Slogan]: 超級簡單、美味的 番茄蘿蔔排骨湯 自然鮮甜的好滋味❤️😚. (2) [Variety]: 超好喝❤️😚. (3) [Slogan]: 乾香菇 先清洗乾淨 溫水浸泡. (4) [Slogan]: 抽一下真空，會更快. (5) [Slogan]: 一旁備用. (6) [Slogan]: 排骨洗乾淨 像這樣搓一搓、釋放雜質. (7) [Slogan]: 先泡15~20分鐘. (8) [Slogan]: 先將蘿蔔 刨去兩三層皮. (9) [Slogan]: 直到蘿蔔摸起來 細細滑滑. (10) [Slogan]: 去掉頭尾. (11) [Slogan]: 取用下半截 熬湯. (12) [Slogan]: 剩下的可以 做涼拌蘿蔔喔. (13) [Slogan]: 蘿蔔切對半、 再對半. (14) [Slogan]: 切成大塊狀. (15) [Slogan]: 使用冷凍番茄 2~3顆. (16) [Slogan]: 冷凍番茄 方便去皮. (17) [Slogan]: 把冷凍番茄 放入水裡. (18) [Slogan]: 像這樣就可以把 番茄皮撕掉. (19) [Slogan]: 不用解凍 切成大塊狀. (20) [Slogan]: 現在排骨已經滲出血水 不需要汆燙 可以直接煮囉！. (21) [Slogan]: 將排骨瀝乾 放入鍋裡. (22) [Slogan]: 白蘿蔔放進來. (23) [Slogan]: 適量的 清酒、冷水.... (24) [Slogan]: 香菇已經泡開了. (25) [Slogan]: 放到湯裡. (26) [Slogan]: 加入一小匙米粒. (27) [Slogan]: 提升湯的甜味❤️. (28) [Slogan]: 開中火加熱. (29) [Slogan]: 邊煮邊撈掉浮沫.... (30) [Slogan]: 直到撈乾淨為止. (31) [Slogan]: 放入番茄塊.... (32) [Slogan]: 一小撮白胡椒粒 可以幫助暖胃. (33) [Slogan]: 1~2包無調味 昆布柴魚高湯包 (增加旨味). (34) [Slogan]: 1大匙的味醂. (35) [Slogan]: 一點鹽 (讓湯有個底味). (36) [Slogan]: 繼續蓋上鍋蓋 先小火燉煮 20分鐘. (37) [Slogan]: 開蓋後， 先取出高湯包. (38) [Slogan]: 再繼續燉煮30分鐘 直到排骨軟嫩.... (39) [Slogan]: 哇～蘿蔔都煮透了 感覺超好喝❤️. (40) [Slogan]: 加了番茄的蘿蔔湯❤️. (41) [Slogan]: 一點香菜增加香氣❤️. (42) [Slogan]: 湯很鮮～. (43) [Slogan]: 番茄的鮮、蘿蔔的甜❤️😚. (44) [Slogan]: 嚐嚐排骨. (45) [Slogan]: 排骨也軟嫩好入口. (46) [Slogan]: 棒透了＠❤️😚. (47) [Slogan]: 更多美味料理 請追蹤我 IG. [Slogan]: 臉書：蘿潔塔的廚房. [Slogan]: YouTube: @RosalinaKitchen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a light, rhythmic acoustic folk BGM featuring a prominent guitar strumming pattern and piano accents. There is no human speech. (2) A sharp 'click' and 'splash' are heard as liquid is poured into a container. This is followed by a mechanical rhythmic 'whooshing' sound from the vacuum pump lid, occurring about four times in quick succession. (3) Rhythmic splashing sounds indicate washing food, followed by the distinctive sound of a peeler scraping against a hard vegetable surface. Sharp, wooden 'thuds' occur as a knife hits the cutting board during chopping. (4) Frozen objects hit the water with a resonant splash. A soft 'tearing' or 'rustling' sound accompanies the peeling of tomato skins. (5) A series of metallic 'clinks' and 'glugs' follow as liquids and solids are added to the pot. A digital 'beep' signals the activation of the induction stove. (6) A low-frequency 'bubbling' white noise sound enters as the soup begins to boil. Metallic scraping from a strainer is heard. (7) A heavy 'thud' of a lid closing is followed by the sound of soup being ladled into a ceramic bowl. (8) The final phase includes clear 'slurping' and 'chewing' sounds as the creator tastes the food. The BGM maintains its tempo and fades out at the very end.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a high-production, step-by-step cooking tutorial aimed at demonstrating a simple yet flavorful tomato and radish pork rib soup. It uses high visual granularity and synchronized audio to emphasize the freshness of ingredients and the ease of the cooking process, concluding with a tasting segment to validate the result and encourage viewers to follow the recipe.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Prominent display of Le Creuset cookware and Hello Kitty tableware, along with CTAs for the creator's social media platforms.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video employs highly effective Foley-style sound editing to enhance the sensory experience of cooking. The fast-paced editing rhythm and clear visual cues make it optimized for short-form social media consumption.
